mapper.select: select p.id, p.name, p.stock, p.low_stock_warning as lowStockWarning, p.status, c.name as categoryName from product p left outer join category c on p.category_id = c.id where p.stock = 0 order by p.update_time desc

select p.id, p.name, p.stock, p.low_stock_warning as lowStockWarning, p.status, c.name as categoryName from product p left outer join category c on p.category_id = c.id where p.stock > 0 and p.stock <= p.low_stock_warning order by p.stock asc

select c.id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, count(p.id) as productCount, coalesce(sum(p.stock), 0) as totalStock from category c left outer join product p on c.id = p.category_id group by c.id, c.name order by totalStock desc
